parameters.description: Head turn; + = toward the screen right (more profile), - = toward the viewer.
Head pitch; + = looks up.
Head tilt; + = clockwise (crown toward the screen right).
0 = closed (lid line), 1 = open.
Happy eye: open -> "◠" squint, closed -> "∩" arc.
Surprise: the eye grows (and the ring a little).
Gaze; + = toward the screen right.
Gaze; + = up.
Brow height; + = raised, - = lowered. The brow shows only when used.
Brow angle; - = angry/determined (lowered toward the beak), + = worried/sad.
Beak opening (lower mandible rotates down). Rev2D lip sync drives it.
Smile line; + = bigger smile, - = frown.
Blush on the face patch.
Inhale: chest swells, head and wings rise.
Body turn; + = toward the screen right.
Lean about the hips (degrees, + = clockwise); the feet stay planted.
Squash (+) and stretch (-) about the feet.
Whole-body position, px; + = screen right (±800 leaves the 1024 px canvas: fly in / out).
Whole-body height, px; - = up (jumps, flight). The shadow stays on the ground.
Contact shadow opacity (0 hides it).
Near wing: 0 folded; + raises it up-left (cheer, flap); -1 points forward (right); -1.5 covers the face.
Near wing opens: folded -> spread feathers.
Near wing tip curls in (holding objects).
Far wing: 0 folded behind the body; + raises it up-right.
Far wing opens.
Tail swing (physics output: do not animate).
Tail up (+) / down (-).
Tail feathers fan out.
Near foot, px; + = screen right.
Near foot, px; - = lifted.
Far foot, px; + = screen right.
Far foot, px; - = lifted.
Feet tucked up and back (flight).
Book: Book held upright on the near wing (reference pose: wing forward, hand curled).
Dictionary: Dictionary held upright on the near wing (reference pose: wing forward, hand curled).
Pointer stick: A wooden teacher's pointer held in the near wing tip.
Chalk: A stick of chalk in the near wing tip (writing on the blackboard).
Pencil: A big yellow pencil held in the near wing tip, point up-right.
Vocabulary card: A flash card held up beside the head by the far wing.
Notepad: A spiral notepad held up by the far wing (Coco writes on it with the pencil).
Blackboard: A blackboard on an easel standing to the right of Coco; AccBoardText writes "Aa" stroke by stroke.
Chalk text on the blackboard: 0 empty … 1 "Aa" fully written (stroke by stroke).
Backpack: A green backpack on the back (shows left of the wing) with a strap across the chest.
Suitcase: A brown suitcase with travel stickers standing on the ground, the near wing resting on it.
Passport: A maroon passport with a gold globe, held up on the near wing.
Map: An unfolded travel map with a dashed route and a red pin, held on the near wing.
Camera: A camera held to the eye with the near wing, lens toward the screen right.
Binoculars: Binoculars held to the eye with the near wing.
Boarding pass: A boarding pass held up beside the head by the far wing.
Compass: A brass compass held on the near wing.
Umbrella: A blue umbrella held up by the far wing.
Explorer hat: A tan explorer (pith) helmet on the crown.
Pilot cap: A navy pilot cap with a black visor and gold wings badge.
Graduation cap: A teacher's mortarboard with a gold tassel.
Sunglasses: Cool round sunglasses over the eye.
Headphones: Blue headphones: the band over the crown, the cup over the ear behind the eye.
Winter scarf: A red and white striped scarf around the neck, one end hanging down the chest.
Raincoat: A yellow raincoat over the body (deforms with it); pair with AccRaincoatHood.
Raincoat hood: The yellow hood around the head (the face patch, eye and beak stay visible).
Trophy: A gold trophy held up beside the head by the far wing.
Medal: A gold medal on a blue and red ribbon around the neck.
Crown: A gold crown with gems on the crown of the head.
Big heart: A big red heart hugged at the chest with the near wing.
Gift box: A red gift box with a gold ribbon and bow, held on the near wing.
Streak badge: A round orange badge with a flame, held up by the far wing (daily streak).
Celebration stars: Big yellow stars around Coco.
Floating hearts: Small red hearts near the head; FxHeartsRise floats them up.
Floating hearts rise (0 … 1 = 60 px up).
Confetti: Colourful confetti above Coco; FxConfettiFall drops it.
Confetti falls (0 … 1 = 330 px down, turning).
Glow: A warm glow behind Coco (level up, big achievements).
Question mark: A blue "?" above the head (asking, confused, curious).
Alert lines: Three short lines bursting from the head (surprise, startle, "aha").
Light bulb: A glowing light bulb above the head (idea, hint available).
Thinking dots: Three dots by the head; FxDot1..3 light them one by one (thinking, AI processing).
Thinking dot 1.
Thinking dot 2.
Thinking dot 3.
Sparkles: Yellow sparkles around the head (delight, new word, success).
Zzz: Three soft blue "Z"s rising from the head (sleeping).
Sweat drop: A light blue sweat drop by the back of the head (nervous, embarrassed).
Tear: A tear under the eye; FxTearFall lets it run down.
The tear runs down (0 … 1 = 40 px).
Dizzy swirl: A swirl above the head; FxDizzySpin turns it.
Dizzy swirl turn (0 … 1 = one full turn).
Music notes: Music notes by the head (singing, dancing, headphones); FxNotesRise floats them up.
Music notes rise (0 … 1 = 50 px).
Camera flash: A white flash burst at the camera lens.
Wall edge: A light wall panel on the left of the canvas for peeking and hiding (scene prop; the app may use its own UI edge instead).

bones.description: Fixed world anchor on the ground line (never animated).
Carries the contact shadow: follows BodyX, shrinks with height.
Whole-body translation (BodyX, BodyY) and squash & stretch about the feet.
Carries the wings and the neck; lifts with each breath.
Upper mandible; follows the face warp at the hinge.
Lower mandible; MouthOpen rotates it down.

warps.description: Whole head: gentle pseudo-3D turn of the outline.
Face patch, eye ring and brow: stronger turn than the outline.
The eye and its highlights: gaze and surprise.

parts.description: Soft contact shadow: stacked translucent ellipses (each subpath is filled on its own, so they build up toward the centre).
Far (left) wing: behind the body, its leading edge shows along the chest.
Far wing coverts (visible when the wing is raised).
Far foot: pad + back toe + two front toes.
Near foot: pad + back toe + two front toes.
Torso, chest and thighs (one shape).
Shade on the far thigh.
Lighter feather edges on the chest.
Near (right) wing: flight feathers (the coverts are drawn on top).
Near wing coverts: lighter, with a scalloped lower edge.
Rounded nape feathers along the back of the neck.
Head feathers (the face patch and beak cover the front).
Light on the crown (same outline as the head, fading out with the gradient).
Soft feather edges on the back of the head.
Bare white face patch (clipped to the head, so it never pokes out when the face turns).
Blush on the face patch (Blush parameter).
Bright ring around the eye.
The black eye (morphs for blinks and expressions).
Brow stroke, only visible when BrowRY / BrowRAngle are used.
Mouth interior: a hidden sliver when closed, follows the jaw when open.
Lower mandible.
Hooked upper mandible.

bindings.description: Looking up tips the beak up.
The head shifts a little toward the turn.
Beak hinge stays on the turning face.
Beak hinge stays on the turning face.
The upper mandible lifts a little.
Open, the interior is the dark gap; the line fades.

animations.description: Breathing: Slow breath: the chest swells, the head bobs a little.
Blinking: A single blink, then a double blink: irregular, so it never looks mechanical.
Looking around: The eye leads, the head follows: right, left, up, back to centre.
Curious head tilt: Tilts the head with a little overshoot, brow up, then back.
Relaxed sway: The body leans gently side to side; the head counter-tilts; the tail follows (physics).
Feather ruffle: A quick shake that fluffs the feathers: squash, shake, tail and wings flare, settle, blink.
Sleeping: Eye closed, head drooped and tilted, slow deep breaths, settled body.
Waking up: From the sleeping pose: the eye flutters open, a big stretch and yawn, then a settle.
Talking: Beak syllables with small nods and an occasional brow lift. Layer with mode "add" over an idle.
Talking softly: A calmer, smaller talk for explanations and quiet moments.
Talking excitedly: Bigger beak, livelier head and a little bounce.
Listening: Head tilted toward the speaker, attentive eye, small encouraging nods.
Thinking: Wing to the chin, eye up, tapping the beak, head slowly tilting.
Waiting patiently: Looks at the learner with a soft smile, gentle sway, a foot tap, blinks.
Explaining: Talks with an open wing gesturing in rhythm, nodding on the stresses.
Nodding: Two quick nods with a smile: "yes".
Shaking the head: A friendly "no": head shakes, worried brow, small frown.
Asking a question: Tilts the head, raises the brow, asks with an open wing.
Having an idea: Eyes pop, a light bulb appears, wing up like a raised finger: "aha!".
Thinking (dots): Thinking pose with three dots lighting up one after another: Coco is working on it.
Greeting: A little hop, then waves with the far wing and says hello with happy eyes.
Saying goodbye: Waves with the near wing raised high, smiles, then a small bow.
Pointing right: Points to the right with the near wing and looks there: directs attention to a UI element.
Pointing left: Points to the left with the near wing and looks there: directs attention to a UI element.
Pointing up: Points up with the near wing and looks there: directs attention to a UI element.
Encouraging: A kind, supportive reaction: reassuring smile, soft nod, open wing ("it's okay, try again").
Introducing itself: Waves hello with the far wing, then lays the near wing on its chest ("I'm Coco!") while talking.
Reading a book: Holds the green book and reads: the eye scans each line, small nods at line breaks.
Teaching: Taps the blackboard with the pointer, then turns to the learner and explains.
Holding a vocabulary card: Holds the word card up with the far wing, smiles at the learner, glances at the card.
Writing: Writes "Aa" on the blackboard with chalk (the letters appear stroke by stroke), then turns round proudly.
Pointing at the board: Points at the blackboard with the wing, looks at it, then back at the learner: "look here!".
Explaining grammar: At the blackboard with the pointer: explains to the learner, taps the example, explains again.
Demonstrating pronunciation: Shows the word card and says it slowly with exaggerated beak shapes ("ee", "oo", "ah").
Presenting a new word: Whips the word card up with a flourish and sparkles, excited "ta-da!", then holds it.
Correcting an answer: A gentle "not quite": small head shake, points to the right answer, then a reassuring nod.
Celebrating a correct answer: Jumps with both wings up, joyful face, tail fanned and sparkles, two happy flaps, lands.
Happy: A bright smile with a little hop, a wing flick and the tail fanned.
Excited: Bounces three times flapping both wings, tail fanned wide.
Proud: Puffs up the chest with a wing on it, chin up, a satisfied nod.
Curious: Leans in for a closer look, tilting the head twice.
Confused: Scratches the head with the far wing, "?" above, head tilting back and forth.
Surprised: A quick hop back with alert lines and wings flaring.
Worried: Fidgets with the wing, glances around, a sweat drop.
Disappointed: A deep sigh: the body sinks a little, head down, then recovers.
Embarrassed: Blushes and hides behind the wing, sweat drop, peeks out shyly.
Playful: A wink, a bouncy head bob and a wagging tail.
Reassuring: Soft smile, slow nod and an open wing: "it's alright".
Mischievous: Sly look, rubbing the wing tips, a little chuckle.
Sad: Head and body droop, a tear runs down, then a brave recovery.
Love: Eyes closed in a happy arc, blushing, swaying, hearts floating up.
Wearing a backpack: Backpack on, wing on the chest, bouncing on its toes, ready to go.
Holding a passport: Shows the passport proudly, glances at it, smiles at the learner.
Looking at a map: Studies the map, looks up and around to get its bearings, back to the map.
With a suitcase: Stands by its suitcase, wing resting on it, tapping a foot, looking around expectantly.
Taking a photograph: Raises the camera to the eye, click (flash), lowers it with a big smile.
Using binoculars: Scans the horizon through binoculars, turning slowly left and right.
Holding a boarding pass: Waves the boarding pass beside the head, excited, glancing at it.
Exploring: Explorer hat and backpack on: leans forward, looks far left and right, points ahead.
Wearing a raincoat: Yellow raincoat and hood, umbrella up: content in the rain, gentle sway, looking up.
Looking at a compass: Studies the compass, turning to find north, then a satisfied nod.
Taking off: Crouches, springs up with big flaps, tucks the legs: ends in the flight pose.
Flying: Flight loop: wings flap, the body lifts on each downstroke, legs tucked, tail up.
Landing: Glides down with wings braking, legs reach for the ground, squashes on touchdown, folds the wings.
Flying in: Flies in from the left edge, glides down and lands in place.
Flying out: Takes off and flies away to the right, out of the screen.
New landmark: In explorer gear: a delighted hop with sparkles, looks around amazed, then points at the landmark.
Jumping: Crouch, a big stretched jump, squash on landing, a happy face.
Flying with excitement: Joyful flight loop: big flaps, swooping up and down, sparkles.
Celebrating: Jumps with both wings up, confetti rains and stars pop, joyful flaps, lands.
Holding a trophy: Holds the gold trophy up beside the head, proud face, sparkles.
Wearing a medal: Medal on the chest, wing pointing to it, chest puffed, sparkles.
Wearing a crown: Crown on, chin up, a slow regal nod, sparkles.
Showing a heart: Hugs a big heart with happy closed eyes and blush; little hearts float up.
Throwing confetti: Flings both wings up: confetti bursts and rains down, joyful face.
Receiving a gift: A gift appears with sparkles; surprised, then delighted, gives it a little shake.
Celebrating a streak: Raises the flame streak badge with a hop, stars burst around, joyful face.
Level up: A warm glow rises around Coco as it floats up with wings spread wide, sparkles, then lands.
Startled: A quick flinch: squash, jolt up, eye wide, alert lines, wings flick out.
Suspicious: Narrowed eye, wing on the chin, a slow lean and sideways glances.
Hiding: Ducks behind the wing, crouched, peeks out once, then comes back out.
Peeking: Hidden behind a wall edge, leans out to peek, looks around, ducks back.
Losing balance: Wobbles on one foot with flailing wings, catches itself, phew.
Dizzy: Head circling, unfocused eye, swaying body, a swirl over the head.
Falling asleep: Eyelids droop, nods off, jerks awake, then drifts off for good.
Looking disappointed: Deflates: a long sigh, body slumps, wings hang, head down; slowly perks back up.
Dramatic surprise: Jumps back stretched tall, both wings up, beak wide open, feathers and tail flared.
Playful dancing: Bobs to the beat, leans side to side, wings and feet alternate, music notes float.
Offline / confused: Shrugs with both wings, "?" above, looks around searching for the connection.
Main idle: Look around + relaxed sway + breathing + blinks, baked into one seamless 8 s loop.
